name: car-tiv
description: CAR-טיב — מאגר סרטוני הרכב הכשר. Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Vite/TypeScript.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test-ui.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply car-tiv-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply car-tiv --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
